title: Elytreproduction
description: This mod adds a way to make more elytras. However, you can only do this after you already have one.
body: Elytreproduction is a mod made by me that allows you to make more elytras using a **blueprint**, which can be crafted using 3 paper and an elytra. It will not be used up upon crafting. The other required item is wings, which can be made using 5 phantom membranes. You require 2 wings, 1 string, and a blueprint to be able to create a new elytra. You might want to install this mod on servers, or if you lose elytras a lot, as it makes getting new ones a lot less tedious.
